title: Restriction normalizations of the actual continuous scalar comparisons
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed field extension, put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and fix a uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $k$ have positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and let all schemes mentioned be separated and of finite type over $k$. Require explicitly that each scheme is Noetherian and finite dimensional and that $\ell$ is invertible in its local rings. On the small pro-etale site put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise operations; regard $E_T$ as an $A_T$-algebra through the canonical isomorphism $A_T\cong(V\mapsto C(|V|,A))$ of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction] followed by postcomposition with the inclusion $A\subset E$. Use the integral category $\mathcal I_T=\Dbc(T,A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and its raw scalar localization $\mathcal R_T=\mathcal I_T[1/\varpi]$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $h:T\to U$ be a $k$-morphism. In the ambient ordinary module derived categories of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] write $P=Lh_A^*$, $Q=Rh_{*,A}$, $P^E=Lh_c^*$ and $Q^E=Rh_{c,*}$, with units and counits $\eta,\epsilon$ and $\eta^E,\epsilon^E$. Write $F_W=E_W\otimes^L_{A_W}-$ and $r_W$ for scalar extension and restriction, and $j_W:\mathrm{id}\to r_WF_W$ for their ambient unit [lem-weil-pbc-realization-scalar-functor]. Use the actual coefficient isomorphism $c_h:h^{-1}A_U\cong A_T$ specified by [lem-weil-pbc-realization-completed-pull], and the specified $E$-coefficient isomorphism obtained by localizing $c_h$ at $\varpi$. Let $\gamma:P|_{\mathcal I_U}\cong Lh^*_{\mathrm{comp}}$ be the actual completion unit, let $\alpha^{\mathrm{comp}}$ be the specified completed scalar-pull comparison, and let $\beta$ be the scalar-push comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-realization-localized-push]. Put $\alpha^o_N=\alpha^{\mathrm{comp}}_NF_T(\gamma_N)$ for $N\in\mathcal I_U$.
The square of coefficient maps with $A_W\to E_W$ commutes: it is the square of [lem-weil-pbc-realization-coefficient-square] for the actual scalar data, with $c_A=c_h$ and $c_E$ the localized $c_h$. The canonical comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction] therefore apply to these actual maps and give natural isomorphisms on the ambient derived categories
$$b:r_TP^E\xrightarrow{\sim}Pr_U,\qquad d:r_UQ^E\xrightarrow{\sim}Qr_T.$$
They have the following simultaneous normalizations, as equalities of derived morphisms (composition is right to left):
$$r_T(\alpha^o_N)j_{T,PN}=b_{F_UN}^{-1}P(j_{U,N})\quad(N\in\mathcal I_U),$$
$$r_U(\beta_M)j_{U,QM}=d_{F_TM}^{-1}Q(j_{T,M})\quad(M\in\mathcal I_T),$$
$$r_T(\epsilon^E_Z)b_{Q^EZ}^{-1}=\epsilon_{r_TZ}P(d_Z)\quad(Z\in D(E_T)).$$
The last formula uses the ambient counit at $r_TZ$; it does not assume that $r_TZ$ is integral constructible. The coefficient square is the square obtained from precomposition on continuous functions, and $b$ uses the unit-preserving inverse-image/localization comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-localization-inverse-image-coherence].

proof.text: Obtain the existing localized-push datum p. Its integral coefficient isomorphism has hom equal to completedCoefficientMap, hence Iso.ext identifies it with realizationRestrictionCoefficient a. The rational coefficient isomorphisms have equal normalized direct-image maps: the sheaf adjunction is injective, and sectionwise their values at every point are equal by their two rational normalization fields. Thus Iso.ext identifies p.rationalPullback with a.rationalCoefficient.

proof.text: Transport p and its beta_normalization through the two coefficient equalities. The adjunction Hom-equivalence formula is unit followed by restriction of beta. Unfolding realizationRestrictionBeta and realizationRestrictionPush yields the second equation. Proof irrelevance identifies the witnesses of the coefficient-square equation.

proof.text: Apply the ring-sheaf-change Hom formula to the rational counit at an arbitrary unbounded Z. Its rational adjunct is the identity by the right triangle identity. Applying the inverse integral Hom equivalence therefore identifies b inverse followed by restriction of the rational counit with P_A(d_Z) followed by the integral canonical counit. Insert the canonical leftAdjointUniq comparison e from the actual ordinary pullback to P_A; naturality of e and its counit compatibility turn this into the actual integral counit. This proves the third equation without a constructibility assumption on r_T Z.
